copy_execution.question: Does Strix generic argument coercion preserve native strict finish rejection semantics?
copy_execution.scope: Exact copied pure AST source contracts, not full owner/PG/SDK/provider/target execution

limitations: Rendered projection/prose and explicitly recorded read extent, not full native raw history or hidden reasoning
Some source renderers omit terminal/proxy outputs, errors, pagination and handoff gaps before DOM
Screenshots exist for every agent; visual analysis is representative by family, not all viewport or WCAG acceptance
No independent replay or certification of the 36 reports; public Python source is not binary attestation

usage.agent_cost_semantics: allocation proportional to total tokens, not each actor billed cost
usage.total_cost_semantics: source prefers observed costs if any, otherwise estimate; equality to provider tallies is not an invoice audit
usage.target_request_limit: 1053 distinct request metadata IDs retained in paged proxy query results describe consulted project records, not a lower bound or total of requests generated by this run. Run/attempt causality is not established by project-ID existence; neither ID deltas nor 661 LLM calls give target HTTP totals.

SSRF via XXE / OOB entity resolution
XSS mitigation controls (CSP, cookie attributes, nosniff)
Exposure of version-control metadata and credentials

limitations: Reporter/source evidence, not independent live replay.

Python executable not rebuilt; 82 prompt/skill/static files match installed bytes.
Private raw transcripts/logs/PoCs and viewer token excluded from Git.
